thread:
Ashley: Quick async standup — roadmap/launch prep for the model routing changes. What I did: merged the updated spec doc for route prioritization, updated the rollout checklist, and synced with docs on telemetry. Blockers: waiting on final sign-off for canary fallback policy from infra. Today: draft canary run plan + ping infra for traffic shaping tests.

Kevin: Noted. FYI I ran a short sweep on KV cache behavior with long contexts and saw token duplication at high batch sizes. I'll open an issue + small repro. Can we add a 'max-batch-for-long-context' check to the checklist?

Maria: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2490 — added telemetry fields and schema. Left 2 comments re: event naming. No blockers from product side.

Sam: Code review ping @Kevin — I addressed your comment about sequence padding in #2488, ready for re-review when you have cycles.

Priyanka: Legal asked for the data retention blurb in the public docs. Uploaded draft here: https://drive.redwood/retention-draft — need product wording to match privacy SLA. Can someone take a quick pass?

Kevin: @Ashley adding the max-batch check now. Also, question on canary: do we want percent-based ramp or qps-based? My preference is qps-based for predictable latency; percent can spike tail latency.

Ashley: Good call — let's do qps-based ramp with a 5m steady window. I'll add that to the plan: 
```
canary_ramp:
  start_qps: 5
  step_qps: 10
  step_duration: 300s
  max_qps: 100
```
Add rollback triggers for >=5% error rate or p95 increase > 50ms.

Sam: Sounds good. I'll add a test that simulates traffic profile and ensures KV cache behaves under that qps.

Maria: I'll adjust telemetry names in the PR to match legal's logging requirements and ping Priyanka for wording.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline queued for canary test branch (branch: feature/route-priority-canary). CI: 8/9 checks passed; failing test is flaky-logger-test, tagging @eng-sre.

Priyanka: I can review the retention wording after Maria updates the telemetry names. Quick ask: include explicit retention windows (30d/90d) in the doc so legal can approve.

Ashley: Thanks team — I'll update the checklist, include the qps-based ramp + rollback rules, and post the final rollout plan by EOD. If anyone hits a blocker ping me in-thread or DM. :thumbsup:
